overview:
West Virginia's 2nd District is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of about R+20. First-term incumbent Riley Moore is running for reelection and has raised more than $1.3 million, leaving over $750,000 on hand. Democrat Ace Parsi has raised about $134,000 with limited cash remaining, and no outside groups appear engaged on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets give Moore roughly a 97% chance of winning. The district's lean, Moore's incumbency and financial advantage, and a favorable national environment for Republicans all point the same direction, making this a safe Republican seat barring unforeseen developments.
